title: Recent development and future perspectives for the electrosynthesis of hydroxylamine and its derivatives
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,10140-10155
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00366K, Review Article
Chaoyue Gu, Jiangchen Zhu, Xiangdong Kong, Zhigang Geng
This review highlights the cutting-edge advances in the electrosynthesis of NH2OH/*NH2OH and its downstream applications, along with the critical challenges and future directions in the electrosynthesis of NH2OH and its derivatives.
